title: 5. Tenure and Qualifications of Rajya Sabha Members

blocks.content:
Tenure:
• Term – 6 years
• One-third members retire every two years
Qualifications:
• Citizen of India
• Minimum age – 30 years
One-third members retire every two years

items: Exams frequently test the retirement frequency: 1/3 of members retire every 2 years.
Pay special attention to the minimum age requirement of 30 years for Rajya Sabha members.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The tenure for a member of Rajya Sabha is 6 years.
One-third of the total members retire at the end of every two years.
An individual must be a citizen of India to be qualified for membership.
The minimum age qualification to become a member of Rajya Sabha is 30 years.
